extracted text: The material was a commercial 7175 high strength aluminium alloy obtained as a forging in the form of a plate, 43 mm in thickness. This plate was further processed to a rolled plate by hot rolling at 738 K from the thickness of 43 to 8.8 mm and cold rolling from 8.8 to 1.5 mm. Specimens were solution treated at 753 K for 70 min, immediately quenched into ambient water and aged at 413 K and 443 K. The paper identifies two peak-aged states during ageing, with aging at 413K for 16h corresponding to the first peak-aged state and 98h corresponding to the second peak-aged state.
